data.title: 阿尼斯 · 竞技场拉拉队胜利跃起加油
data.description: 前哨基地模拟战竞技场边，阿尼斯身着红白配色的亮眼拉拉队短裙。她高举双手的红色绒花彩球凌空跃起，短裙飘扬展露出充满活力的健康腰肢，活力四射地为大获全胜的指挥官振臂欢呼。

data.animaCaption: She leaps high with pom-poms raised, shouting happily for the viewer.

data.title: 梦梦 · 南瓜灯旁的幽灵恶作剧
data.description: 夜里的庭院摆着几盏南瓜灯。梦梦坐在覆着白布的长椅上，幽灵兜帽垂在粉色卷发两侧，连衣裙上的层叠布条随着前倾的动作轻轻晃动。她抬起双手，蜷着手指朝你装鬼，努力绷住表情，尾巴尖却已经在身后翘了起来。
data.location: 结城家庭院的南瓜灯长椅旁
data.action: 坐在覆白布的长椅上，上身微微前倾，双手抬至脸颊两侧，蜷起手指朝观众装鬼
data.lighting: warm jack-o-lantern light, cool night ambient light
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, front view
data.mood: 假装认真吓人，藏不住恶作剧的笑意
data.promptProse: Momo sits on a white-draped garden bench at night, leaning slightly toward the viewer with both hands beside her cheeks and her fingers curled in a playful ghost gesture. Her expression is mock-serious, and her tail curves out beside the bench. Glowing jack-o-lanterns behind her cast warm orange light against the cool night surroundings. The frontal eye-level composition includes her hood, both hands and the layered dress.
data.animaCaption: Her hood has two black oval eye patches; she curls both hands beside her cheeks to play a ghost toward the viewer, with glowing jack-o-lanterns behind the white-draped bench.

data.title: 拉毗 · 军械整备室步枪擦拭与沉静侧颜
data.description: 基地地下军械整备库内，拉毗身穿反击小队标准战术制服，外套随意搭在椅背。她正专注地拆解保养突击步枪核心枪机，金属冷光映照着她冷峻利落的侧脸轮廓，举手投足间尽显精英妮姬的沉稳与专业。

data.animaCaption: She meticulously cleans her rifle parts at the armory workbench under a desk lamp.

data.title: 拉毗 · 战术靶场沉稳立射正中靶心

data.promptProse: Lowering her assault rifle as a faint wisp of smoke curls from the muzzle, her stance remains rock-solid in the underground range. Overhead fluorescent strips illuminate her scarlet gaze as she turns calmly to confirm target elimination.
data.animaCaption: She lowers her smoking rifle at the firing range, turning back with a calm, focused gaze.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 幽暗古堡夜宴的黑金礼裙回眸
data.description: 维多利亚古老庄严的黑石古堡宴会厅内，塔露拉身着一袭带有德拉克古老金纹的绯红露肩丝绒礼裙。高开叉裙摆随着步伐展露优美身段，她回眸望向镜头，手轻扶佩剑般的黑金长柄权杖，展现出龙裔王室血脉无可匹敌的高贵与骄傲。
data.location: 维多利亚黑石古堡穹顶夜宴长厅
data.action: 执权杖驻足回眸，黑色高开叉礼裙轻摆，龙角威严耸立
data.lighting: 巨型水晶烛台垂落的庄重金辉与古堡阴影
data.promptProse: Sweeping through the vaulted stone ballroom in an off-shoulder crimson and black velvet gown, gold draconic embroidery catches the candlelight. Her towering horns and trailing tail command the hall as she pauses to look back with imperial poise.
data.animaCaption: She pauses in the vaulted gothic ballroom in a crimson and black velvet gown, her gaze regal.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 铁血王座黑金礼裙掀起的炽热沉沦
data.description: 核心城幽暗高耸的铁血王座上，塔露拉斜倚在深色石座靠背前。绯红丝绒礼裙的高开叉被向两侧掀开，白皙紧致的龙裔修长美腿搭在王座扶手上。她双手抓着扶手的龙首雕饰，胸口急促起伏，龙角与龙尾因高热而泛红，骄傲的头颅微仰，在炽热喘息中卸下所有王者防线。
data.location: 核心城顶端昏暗冰冷的铁血王座大殿
data.action: 斜靠石座王座，礼裙掀起露腿，手抓扶手仰头微喘
data.lighting: 王座两侧高脚火盆跃动的熊熊烈火
data.promptProse: Reclining back across the massive basalt throne, the crimson silk of her gown is gathered past her porcelain thighs. Twin iron braziers flare across the hall, illuminating her arched neck and the red flush spreading along her draconic horns as she gasps softly.
data.animaCaption: She leans back on the stone throne with parted skirts, her breathing heavy in the firelight.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 炽热温泉湿身扶石回眸的龙尾交缠
data.description: 隐秘地热溶洞中的私人温泉，翻滚的水汽中弥漫着矿石与源石的温热气息。塔露拉褪尽衣物伏在温热的天然石台上，如瀑银灰湿发贴在光洁美背上。她回过头来，金瞳里满是湿润的迷乱与动摇，细长的龙尾轻轻勾住你的小腿，在水汽蒸腾中迎向滚烫的拥抱。
data.location: 地热溶洞深处的私人天然石穴温泉
data.action: 双手扶石台伏卧，湿发贴背，回眸娇喘，龙尾勾缠依偎
data.lighting: 溶洞天然发光萤石与地热红光的幽暗辉映
data.camera: cowboy shot, from behind, looking over shoulder
data.promptProse: Leaning forward against the smooth hot spring ledge, water cascades down her arched, unclad back and silver hair. Amber cave minerals reflect in the vapor as she glances back with parted lips, her tail gently encircling the viewer's ankle.
data.animaCaption: She leans over the steamy hot spring rock, looking back over her bare shoulder with glassy golden eyes.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 行军营帐兽皮厚毯上的深红吊带缠绵
data.description: 大雪封山的前线行军营帐深处，白熊厚兽皮毯铺满地面。塔露拉仅身穿一袭极薄的深红丝绸吊带睡裙躺在厚毯上，细肩带滑落至手臂，胸前蕾丝领口泛着剧烈起伏。她一手挡在迷离的红瞳前，另一手紧抓毯边，温热龙尾轻轻缠绕向你，在极北严寒中独享滚烫的私密温存。
data.location: 极地中军暖帐内铺着兽皮软毯的榻上
data.action: 卧在白兽皮毯上，吊带滑落香肩，手遮双眸娇喘，龙尾依恋相缠
data.lighting: 暖帐中央铁皮暖炉散发的炭火暗红微光
data.promptProse: Lying back into the thick white fur rug inside the heated camp tent, the slender strap of her crimson silk chemise slips down her arm. The dull glow of the coal stove reveals her flushed throat and the gentle curl of her tail in breathless surrender.
data.animaCaption: She reclines on the fur rug in her slipped silk chemise, her dragon tail curling close in the ember glow.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 行军营帐内的烛光沙盘沉思
data.description: 深夜的整合运动前线行军大营内，塔露拉脱下厚重的军官大衣挂在架上，内穿修身黑色军装衬衫。她一手按在乌萨斯行军沙盘边缘，另一手抚着下颌凝视地图，烛火摇曳在她深沉坚毅的面颊上，身后龙尾随沉思缓缓摆动。
data.location: 整合运动中军行军大帐
data.action: 手按沙盘审视战役地图，神情深沉凝思
data.lighting: 桌案上数支蜡烛的昏黄烛火与帐帘微弱蓝光
data.promptProse: Leaning over the strategy table in her campaign tent, her heavy coat set aside to reveal a crisp dark uniform shirt. Flickering candlelight dances across her draconic horns and deep amber eyes as she studies the frozen routes ahead.
data.animaCaption: She leans over the strategy table in the candlelit tent, her gaze contemplative.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 废墟尖塔残照下的飞雪与火烬
data.description: 夕阳残照洒满切尔诺伯格破损的旧钟塔天台。塔露拉身着高领厚毛衣与长靴迎风伫立在断壁旁，指尖燃着一簇温和微弱的小火苗。她眺望着远方无垠的感染者土地，冷峻的神色中流露出一丝对和平的深切追寻与落寞。
data.location: 被战争摧毁的旧钟塔残破尖顶
data.action: 指尖托着微弱火苗眺望远方，微风吹拂长发
data.lighting: 冬日血色残阳与指尖微弱火苗的幽光
data.promptProse: Standing on the crumbling rooftop parapet against a bruised winter sunset, a gentle ember hovers above her bare fingertip. Her cream knit sweater shields her from the biting wind as she gazes into the horizon with quiet, solemn resolve.
data.animaCaption: She stands at the ruined tower edge watching the crimson sunset with an ember at her fingertip.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 极北雪原的烈焰长剑出鞘
data.description: 暴风雪肆虐的乌萨斯冻原荒野，塔露拉身披整合运动黑白领袖风衣屹立于风雪之巅。她单手拔出燃烧着源石烈火的修长佩剑，炽热烈焰将漫天飞雪瞬间汽化，金红眼眸锋芒毕露，尽显整合运动领袖傲视风雪的帝王威仪。
data.location: 乌萨斯极北雪原荒野废墟顶端
data.action: 拔出烈焰长剑直指前方，风衣在暴风雪中翻飞，眼神威严凌厉
data.lighting: 暴风雪阴霾下的佩剑炽烈火光与剑刃反光
data.promptProse: Standing atop a frozen parapet amid the howling tundra blizzard, she draws her blade enveloped in searing golden flames. Her black and white officer's coat whips in the gale as her dragon horns catch the fiery brilliance of her gaze.
data.animaCaption: She draws her blazing sword against the raging blizzard, her golden eyes blazing with command.

data.title: 塔露拉 · 熔岩地热温泉边的绯红比基尼侧影
data.description: 地底炽热地热泉眼的黑曜石池畔，塔露拉换上炽火般的深红挂脖比基尼。她站在蒸腾的硫磺热泉边，单手轻理长发，黑色龙尾在水面激起涟漪，结实而优美的龙裔肌肉线条在水汽与地热红光中展露出野性与力量之美。
data.location: 地底火山口地热黑曜石温泉畔
data.action: 单手理发伫立泉边，龙尾划过水面，英姿飒爽
data.lighting: 地下地热熔岩红光与温泉水汽折射
data.promptProse: Standing atop black obsidian boulders above the steaming geothermal pool, her fiery halterneck bikini accentuates a powerful, graceful silhouette. Steam curls around her crimson dragon horns as her tail skims the mineral water.
data.animaCaption: She stands by the volcanic hot spring in a crimson bikini, steam swirling around her horns.
